scope: Root visual review of everyday character in a desktop browser, including 128px rendering. Temporal frames extracted at 4fps from normal playback and 1fps from quarter playback. Physical devices untested.

motions.finding: Both original short arms lift beside the face with visible elbow flexion, open outward, and return smoothly to Idle. Front, rear, both sides and 45-degree skeleton overlays keep joints inside their limb silhouettes. Normal 128px and quarter-speed temporal frames show readable raised hands, mild weight shift and no observed abrupt elbow reversal or unsupported body jump.
